notes.title: 👩‍💼👨‍💼 Startup Panic is live on Steam now!
notes.content:
Quit your job and build a STARTUP from scratch!

Startup Panic is out on Steam and the game is 10% off now!

https://i.imgur.com/kkqrFgN.gif

👩‍💼👨‍💼 PLAY NOW: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045610/Startup_Panic/

This game is a tech-tycoon simulator ideal for players new to the genre - or veterans looking for a bit of personality as their small company conquers the corporate world.

It is all about surviving the tech bubble, competing with rival CEOs, and expanding the office from bedroom programmer up to the heights of global corporate sabotage! As long as you don't get hacked... or kidnapped…
🔴Watch the launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=Bb9L5ik9PmA;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can imagine, entrepreneurship is not easy and you get to experience realistic situations a Startup founder will encounter. Work out your strategies carefully and conquer the globe!

https://i.imgur.com/dYgOWAR.gif
https://i.imgur.com/Iw8i3g6.gif

[olist]
 Develop, revise and upgrade your features as they are the cornerstone of your business’ success.
 Form a great team with various hiring approaches, train your staff and grant vacations to keep them motivated!
 Compete with rival CEOs, deal with constant threats on the market share and expand to build branches in the entire globe!
 Most importantly, keep your company afloat and nurture a positive brand impression!
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

New features:
If you have tried out the game before, please note that this launch on Steam has added a couple of new features that you have never seen before! 

https://i.imgur.com/DJycwAp.gif


 Competitor CEOs that you defeated will return later with additional comeback-themed content and an option to upgrade your features to Advanced versions;
 A ghost-busting questline is triggered when you start to discover some haunted incidents in your office!
 Long-term loyal employees will earn new traits after gaining experience;
 Choose from Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty levels to face with challenges that suit your preferences;
 Some updates on balance and clarity. 


https://i.imgur.com/8z7lFQz.gif

Ready to write your business legend now? We look forward to seeing your great Startups!

In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages!

Have fun and best of luck, entrepreneurs!

notes.title: Play Startup Panic’s demo during Steam Next Fest and watch the gameplay stream!
notes.content:
Greetings entrepreneurs!

The Steam Next Fest starts TODAY, and we can’t wait for you to create business legends of your own!

Have you ever wondered what it’d be like to have your own Startup business? Here is a chance to test it out now in Startup Panic’s demo! 

This game is a highly customizable tech-business management sim ideal for players new to the genre - or veterans looking for a bit of personality as their small company conquers the corporate world.

https://i.imgur.com/DwFitgr.gif

[hr][/hr]

It is all about surviving the tech bubble, competing with rival CEOs, and expanding the office from bedroom programmer up to the heights of global corporate sabotage! As long as the players don't get hacked... or kidnapped…

Work your way to over seven unique victories - including becoming President or even setting up a colony on Mars!

There is also a gameplay stream on the page so check it out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045610/Startup_Panic/

[hr][/hr]

Without further ado, let’s take a deep dive into the main game features!

👨‍💻 - Decide how each project goes and what to focus on.

https://i.imgur.com/B2v7d9h.gif

With an expansive business customization tree, choose appropriate features to develop for your Startup and assign different priority indexes to a list of aspects (Technology, Usability, Aesthetic) to secure favorable user reviews.  

🌆- Upgrade your company in the skill tree: Will you take longer vacations or cheaper air-con? 

https://i.imgur.com/LMUDU9i.gif

Take complete control of your startup’s development path, including the office design - you have a wide range of tools to run your new business your way. Grow from a garage office to a global conglomerate that has a built-in gym and cafeteria!

👨‍💼👩‍💼- Train your staff and hunt for new employees

https://i.imgur.com/CscatPT.gif

Send your staff to a training session on coding or a well-earned vacation in a dinosaur theme park. Your employees' motivations, personalities, and skills are your crucial cornerstones to success, so always keep a close eye on their requests and needs.

Choose from various hiring approaches to get the new ones that fit your style whenever you are shorthanded: Social butterfly? Marketing expert? Lone Wolf? It is all your decision!

🗺️- Compete with rival CEOs for new users in your region, and then expand out by building new headquarters on a world map! 

https://i.imgur.com/o3NuBZn.gif

Once you start hiring your first employees and upgrading your office, you'll attract the attention of competing businesses. Please be aware of the lurking competitors in the ever-changing markets and move fast to defeat them and take on new users before they eat up the cake.

https://i.imgur.com/H2zuT3g.gif

The scope of Startup Panic is more significant than it may seem at first glance, much like your ambition! With a growing world map, you can drop your next base of operations at whichever location you prefer.

💵- Take out a loan or search for investors

https://i.imgur.com/h5OriIt.gif

Like startups in real life, earning more CASH to ensure your business' survival will be the primary goal in the earlier stages (or maybe for the entire entrepreneurship). And we get it; it is not always easy to get by smoothly. Thus we have made sure you can reach out to investors or take out a loan when you need some extra cash but don't think it'll come for free…

[hr][/hr]

Ready to write your business legend now? Visit our store page, and don't forget to WISHLIST so you can get all future release news and updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045610/Startup_Panic/

In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages!


 Discord
 Facebook
 Twitter
 Website


That’s it for today, see you at Steam Next Fest and we hope to see your great Startups soon!
